actionConfiguration.body:
with estado_borrador as (
  select id
  from public.estados_cargue_planta
  where codigo = 'BORRADOR'
  limit 1
),

cargue_existente as (
  select id
  from public.cargues_planta_exportacion
  where tenant_id =
        '{{ appsmith.store.cp_tenant_id }}'::uuid

    and exportacion_id =
        '{{ appsmith.store.cp_exportacion_id }}'::uuid

    and activo = true
  limit 1
),

cargue_creado as (
  insert into public.cargues_planta_exportacion (
    tenant_id,
    exportacion_id,
    booking_id,
    proforma_id,
    estado_cargue_id,
    modalidad_transporte_id,
    tipo_carga_id,
    caracteristica_carga_id,
    created_by,
    updated_by
  )
  select
    '{{ appsmith.store.cp_tenant_id }}'::uuid,

    '{{ appsmith.store.cp_exportacion_id }}'::uuid,

    nullif(
      '{{ appsmith.store.cp_booking_id || "" }}',
      ''
    )::uuid,

    nullif(
      '{{ appsmith.store.cp_proforma_id || "" }}',
      ''
    )::uuid,

    (select id from estado_borrador),

    nullif(
      '{{ appsmith.store.cp_modalidad_transporte_id || "" }}',
      ''
    )::uuid,

    nullif(
      '{{ appsmith.store.cp_tipo_carga_id || "" }}',
      ''
    )::uuid,

    nullif(
      '{{ appsmith.store.cp_caracteristica_carga_id || "" }}',
      ''
    )::uuid,

    nullif(
      '{{ appsmith.store.user_id || "" }}',
      ''
    )::uuid,

    nullif(
      '{{ appsmith.store.user_id || "" }}',
      ''
    )::uuid

  where not exists (
    select 1
    from cargue_existente
  )

  returning id
),

cargue_final as (
  select id
  from cargue_existente

  union all

  select id
  from cargue_creado

  limit 1
),

vehiculo_final as (
  select
    nullif(
      '{{ qCpBuscarVehiculoPorPlaca.data?.[0]?.vehiculo_id || "" }}',
      ''
    )::uuid as vehiculo_id,

    nullif(
      '{{ qCpBuscarVehiculoPorPlaca.data?.[0]?.tenant_vehiculo_id || "" }}',
      ''
    )::uuid as tenant_vehiculo_id
),

conductor_final as (
  select
    nullif(
      '{{ qCpBuscarConductorPorDocumento.data?.[0]?.conductor_id || "" }}',
      ''
    )::uuid as conductor_id,

    nullif(
      '{{ qCpBuscarConductorPorDocumento.data?.[0]?.tenant_conductor_id || "" }}',
      ''
    )::uuid as tenant_conductor_id
),

next_viaje as (
  select
    coalesce(max(viaje_no), 0) + 1
      as viaje_no

  from public.cargues_planta_vehiculos

  where tenant_id =
        '{{ appsmith.store.cp_tenant_id }}'::uuid

    and cargue_id =
        (select id from cargue_final)

    and placa =
        upper(trim('{{ inpCpPlaca.text || "" }}'))

    and activo = true
),

next_item as (
  select
    coalesce(max(item_no), 0) + 1
      as item_no

  from public.cargues_planta_vehiculos

  where tenant_id =
        '{{ appsmith.store.cp_tenant_id }}'::uuid

    and cargue_id =
        (select id from cargue_final)

    and activo = true
)

insert into public.cargues_planta_vehiculos (
  tenant_id,
  cargue_id,
  exportacion_id,

  vehiculo_id,
  tenant_vehiculo_id,

  conductor_id,
  tenant_conductor_id,

  item_no,
  viaje_no,

  tipo_vehiculo_terrestre_id,
  placa,

  tipo_remolque_catalogo_id,
  placa_remolque,

  marca_vehiculo,
  modelo_vehiculo,
  color_vehiculo,
  capacidad_carga_kg,

  soat_no,
  soat_vencimiento,

  conductor_documento,
  conductor_nombre,
  conductor_licencia,
  conductor_telefono,
  conductor_estado,

  created_by,
  updated_by
)

select
  '{{ appsmith.store.cp_tenant_id }}'::uuid,

  (select id from cargue_final),

  '{{ appsmith.store.cp_exportacion_id }}'::uuid,

  (select vehiculo_id
   from vehiculo_final),

  (select tenant_vehiculo_id
   from vehiculo_final),

  (select conductor_id
   from conductor_final),

  (select tenant_conductor_id
   from conductor_final),

  (select item_no
   from next_item),

  (select viaje_no
   from next_viaje),

  nullif(
    '{{ slCpTipoVehiculo.selectedOptionValue || "" }}',
    ''
  )::uuid,

  upper(
    trim('{{ inpCpPlaca.text || "" }}')
  ),

  nullif(
    '{{ slCpTipoRemolque.selectedOptionValue || "" }}',
    ''
  )::uuid,

  nullif(
    upper(
      trim('{{ inpCpPlacaRemolque.text || "" }}')
    ),
    ''
  ),

  upper(
    trim(
      '{{ slCpMarcaVehiculo.selectedOptionValue || "" }}'
    )
  ),

  upper(
    trim('{{ inpCpModeloVehiculo.text || "" }}')
  ),

  upper(
    trim(
      '{{ slCpColorVehiculo.selectedOptionValue || "" }}'
    )
  ),

  nullif(
    '{{ inpCpCapacidadCargaKg.text || "" }}',
    ''
  )::numeric,

  upper(
    trim('{{ inpCpSoatNo.text || "" }}')
  ),

  nullif(
    '{{ dpCpSoatVencimiento.selectedDate || "" }}',
    ''
  )::date,

  upper(
    trim('{{ inpCpCedulaConductor.text || "" }}')
  ),

  upper(
    trim('{{ inpCpNombreConductor.text || "" }}')
  ),

  upper(
    trim('{{ inpCpLicenciaConductor.text || "" }}')
  ),

  trim(
    '{{ inpCpTelefonoConductor.text || "" }}'
  ),

  nullif(
    upper(
      trim('{{ txtCpEstadoConductor.text || "" }}')
    ),
    ''
  ),

  nullif(
    '{{ appsmith.store.user_id || "" }}',
    ''
  )::uuid,

  nullif(
    '{{ appsmith.store.user_id || "" }}',
    ''
  )::uuid

where
  (select vehiculo_id
   from vehiculo_final) is not null

  and
  (select tenant_vehiculo_id
   from vehiculo_final) is not null

  and
  (select conductor_id
   from conductor_final) is not null

  and
  (select tenant_conductor_id
   from conductor_final) is not null

returning
  id as cargue_vehiculo_id,
  cargue_id,

  vehiculo_id,
  tenant_vehiculo_id,

  conductor_id,
  tenant_conductor_id,

  placa,
  viaje_no,
  item_no;
